agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Monday, March 17, 2014 - 07:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Traina
d.
Roll Call
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation by K.C. Nash, Interim Executive Director and Erick Serrato, Communications Officer with the Pacific Gateway Workforce Investment Network.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Lomita Housing Authority and Regular City Council meeting held on March 3, 2014 and the Special Meeting of the Regular City Council-Strategic Planning Workshop held on March 5, 2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
2014-03-03 HA Minutes
2014-03-03 CC Minutes
2014-03-05 Minutes Special Meeting Workshop
c.
Adopt Resolution 2014-11, Approving the Demands and Payroll. RECOMMEND ADOPT RESOLUTION.
2014-03-17 Demands Item 7.c
d.
Discussion and Approval of the Disposal of Equipment. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
2014-03-17 Staff Report 7.d
e.
Discussion and Approval of an extension of the City's Street Sweeping Contract with R.F. Dickson Co. Inc. for a two year period. The annual cost of the contract will be $92,439. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
2014-03-17 Staff Report 7.e
f.
Direct the Mayor to sign a letter to the Pacific Gateway Workforce Investment Board. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
2014-03-17 Staff Report 7.f
g.
Direct the Mayor to sign a letter opposing the reopening of a Heliport at LAX. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
2014-03-17 Staff Report 7.g
PUBLIC HEARING:
8.
ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT ON THE GENERAL PLAN FOR 2013 A review of the 2013 Annual Progress Report on the General Plan and possible direction to submit the 2013 Annual Progress Report on the General Plan to the Governor's Office of Planning and Research (OPR) and to State Housing and Community Development (HCD).
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
2014-03-17 Staff Report 8
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
LOMITA BOULEVARD RESURFACING PROJECT FROM NARBONNE AVENUE TO EAST CITY LIMIT Discussion and consideration of reprogramming excess Proposition C funds for street pavement improvement along Lomita Blvd. from Narbonne Avenue to the eastern City Limit. Possible direction to staff to proceed with the preparation of plans, specifications and bid documents for the purpose of retaining a contractor to resurface the aforementioned street. The cost estimate to complete this project is $800,000.
Presented by Acting Public Works Director Shahbazi
2014-03-17 Staff Report 9
10.
REHABILITATION OF THE HARBOR HILLS WATER STORAGE TANK Discussion and possible direction authorizing staff to proceed with the preparation of plans, specifications and bid documents for the Harbor Hills Water Storage Tank Rehabilitation Project located on Palos Verdes Drive North west of Western Avenue. The cost estimate to complete this project is $390,000.
Presented by Acting Public Works Director Shahbazi
2014-03-17 Staff Report 10
11.
APPROVE THE 50TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION OF CITY INCORPORATION AND SET THE DATE OF JUNE 28, 2014 AS THE CELEBRATION DAY.
Presented by City Manager Rock
2014-03-17 Staff Report 11
12.
OVERVIEW OF THE CITY'S CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT (CIP) PROGRAM Discussion of CIP projects including street improvement projects to include the following:
? Historical background on available resources for capital improvement funding Summary of the City's 5 Year CIP adopted in 2013
? Overview of the Pavement Management Schedule
? CIP projects completed in recent years
? Available funding sources for CIPs
? Status of FY 2013-2014 CIP Projects
? CIP project recommendations for FY 2014-2015
? CIP projects for the subsequent four years and changes to the previously approved 5 Year CIP
Presented by City Manager Rock and Acting Public Works Director Shahbazi
2014-03-17 Staff Report 12
13.
ADJOURNMENT Lomita City Council will adjourn to a Regular Meeting on April 7, 2014 at 7:00 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
